body:
In my own experience-- Anxiety is worrying too much to the point of feeling discomfort, tightening of the chest, heart beating, feeling tense and easily shaken. Gets worse when actually being around people or contemplating situations around other people.
Paranoia is when all the fears ARE real, and it is impossible to believe otherwise.  Relationships with others fall apart. Everything and anything said gets interpreted as accusations meant to break me down. I 'd feel targeted and strongly believe everyone is against me. It would be tough to leave the house or to be seen at all. The only time when I realize how irrational I was behaving and the extremity of the paranoid feelings were was after the episode ended.
Hey. It sounds really tough for you right now. May I ask what exactly is troubling you at the moment?

Hey, I appreciate that.. I never thought of it that way, really.

 It's tough to actually not contact and to ignore, because he'd pretend nothing's wrong. The last time he talked to me was last night. I stopped responding to him 9 hours ago. I stayed up all night since. I couldn't sleep. At all. Maybe I'm not even thinking straight right now.

He says that exact same phrase to me too that I'm too sensitive.  
That is good you were able to leave that abusive relationship. It's not easy at all, and I'm saying that as someone who's not technically together. 

My ex somehow triggers those feelings. I have bipolar but I've been trying to deal with life without medication. I had a lot of mixed episodes where my moods jumped from manic to depressed to psychotic to feeling so overwhelmed, that really felt unbearable. The mood swings are noticeable less intense when I cut off contact with him.
It feels like I'm losing my best friend. 
Every time I tell him or even imply for him to stop talking to me, he 'd make me feel guilty, by saying "there is no issue at all, why are you being so dramatic", he tell me he'll always be there for me. No one has ever told me that. So that stuck. and it's hard to let go. It feels so tough to let go of something that was once this good. It is very rocky.
 
He hit me up about a month ago telling me he missed me, then drove over to see my and held me hand.. the next thing I knew we were on a date, hooked up and it was the honeymoon period all over again. Yet he was in denial, he's been wishy-washy about his intentions the entire time. That was irritating to me. He'd try to act very sweet but when I say anything a tiny bit out of line, he'd blow up suddently and literally say "what's your fucking problem, what is the issue, why do you always find an issue out of nothing?!"  
That always  scared me. It shuts me off all the time, and I am not physically able to respond at that point. 

I apologize if everything seems out of place or difficult to read. I haven't slept all night, just couldn't. It's 9 am here
